verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is operated through programmatic SDKs (Python, JS, Go) and a conventional CLI. The evidence shows no first-party natural-language command interface. The agent example and the llms.txt file are developer building blocks: they let someone build an LLM agent that uses sandboxes, but they do not let a user operate Modal itself in natural language, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
